issues.legal_issue: A banana plantation does not qualify as an orchard for an intermediary’s claim to retain land on that basis.
material_facts: An intermediary claimed a right to retain land that included mango and jackfruit trees, bamboo clumps, and banana plants.
The High Court held that a banana plantation was not an orchard because banana plants were not fruit trees, and the intermediary challenged that conclusion.
The Court found that banana plants are seasonal, become useless after yielding fruit, and have fleshy or herbaceous rather than woody stems.
issues.conclusion: A banana plant is not a fruit tree, so a banana plantation is not an orchard within the meaning of the land-retention provision. The Court declined to interfere with the High Court’s decision and dismissed the petition.
issues.legal_principle: Section 2(p) of the West Bengal Estate Acquisition Act, 1954 permits reference to the meaning under the applicable land-tenure law. The Court looked to section 14K(e) of the West Bengal Land Reforms Act, which describes an orchard as a compact area bearing fruit trees in such number that they preclude, or when fully grown would preclude, a substantial part of the land from agricultural use. A tree must be perennial and have a woody main stem; a banana plant, being seasonal and herbaceous, does not meet those characteristics. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: orchard_based_retention_claim and banana_plantation_present and (banana_plants_not_perennial or banana_stems_not_woody)

predicates.orchard_based_retention_claim: An intermediary claimed entitlement to retain land on the basis that it was an orchard.
predicates.banana_plantation_present: The land claimed for retention included a plantation of banana plants.
predicates.banana_plants_not_perennial: The banana plants were seasonal and ceased to be useful for further fruit production after yielding fruit.
predicates.banana_stems_not_woody: The banana plants had fleshy or herbaceous stems rather than woody trunks.
predicates.banana_plantation_not_orchard: The banana plantation does not qualify as an orchard.

issues.definition: When an intermediary claims land retention on an orchard basis and the land includes banana plants that are nonperennial or have nonwoody stems, the banana plantation does not qualify as an orchard.
